messages:
Incident Bot: ALERT: High packet loss and partial egress failure observed from eu-west-1 -> upstream provider ASN 64584. Severity: P2. Paging oncall.
Oncall Network: +1. I'm on it.
Maya Tran: seeing elevated 5xx for hosted endpoints in EU from synthetic monitors. Correlation with egress problems?
Liam Khan: confirmed. Traces show timeouts to external partners and high retransmits. Not internal cluster issues so far.
Jordan (SRE): attaching quick bgp/snmp dump I grabbed from edge routers: ```
BGP summary for neighbor 203.0.113.1 (AS64584):
  State: Established, Prefixes: 12, Updates: 762
  Last reset: 00:12:34
  RIB: some prefixes intermittently withdrawn
---
show ip bgp 198.51.100.0/24
  *> 203.0.113.1  0.0.0.0  i  communities: 64584:100
  (path flapping detected)
``` 
Oncall Network: traceroute from eu-west-egress node -> 198.51.100.1 shows hop 5 blackholed/lossy. ```
traceroute to 198.51.100.1 (198.51.100.1), 30 hops max
 1  10.0.0.1  0.5 ms
 2  192.0.2.1  1.2 ms
 3  198.51.100.254  10.4 ms
 4  203.0.113.254  * * *
 5  198.51.100.1  * * *
``` 
Runtime Eng: streaming endpoints use long-lived connections—customers will see partial disconnects. We need to failover egress for EU workloads ASAP.
Maya Tran: can we flip EU traffic to the secondary transit? What's the risk to latency?
Liam Khan: secondary provider has announced capacity; expected <10ms extra median RTT but we need to update BGP prepends and communities. I'll prepare a temporary prepend policy and community strip.
Jordan (SRE): rolling a policy now on eu-west-1 edge: setlocalpref for prefixes towards ASN 64584 -> decrease, prepend to alternate ASN 64585. Command snippet: ```
neighbor 203.0.113.1 route-map RM-DEPRIORITIZE out
route-map RM-DEPRIORITIZE permit 10
 set local-preference 50
!
neighbor 198.51.100.2 route-map RM-PROMOTE out
route-map RM-PROMOTE permit 10
 set as-path prepend 64585 64585 64585
``` 
Oncall Network: applied on 3/3 edge routers. Waiting for BGP convergence. Watching BGP table and community tags.
OpsBot: SYSTEM: Canary health checks for eu-hosted API show error rate jump from 0.5% -> 6.8% over last 10m. Streaming drop rate: 4.3%.
Emma (Customer Success): escalating to a handful of paying customers who reported streaming disconnects. Drafting a proactive customer note.
Maya Tran: DNS note: some customers use direct peering to upstream and depend on specific AS path. Do we want to reduce TTLs and update loadbalancer weights? TTL already 60 for api-eu. Suggest leave TTL low until resolved.
Liam Khan: BGP convergence observed: most prefixes moved to alternate provider. Packet loss for affected prefixes dropped from 35% -> 2% on edge. Synthetic errors improving.
Jordan (SRE): rolling back prepends on prefixes that show stable path back to primary? Not yet; primary still withdrawing intermittently. Recommend keep alternate for 30m and monitor.
Runtime Eng: patching streamer reconnect backoff to be more aggressive for EU region (short-term mitigation) — deploying canary in 2m.
Oncall Network: FYI, upstream provider AS64584 reporting an internal link failure in peering POP BRU-2, they are engineering a repair. ETA 22-35 minutes per their status page.
Emma (Customer Success): sent initial customer advisory: short description, impact, mitigation (traffic diverted), ETA. Will update once provider confirms fix. :white_check_mark:
Maya Tran: also seeing one customer with higher token-latency for embeddings (30% higher p95) — looks like cache misses due to new path. Monitoring.
Liam Khan: noting for postmortem: consider automated multi-asn failover for eu regions + auto-bgp-prepend playbook.
Jordan (SRE): collecting logs for RCA. Please avoid further manual BGP tweaks unless coordinated here.
Oncall Network: manual intervention paused. Observability: edge egress loss steady ~1.8% now.
Incident Bot: REMINDER: Create incident page (inc/1793502468) and start timeline. Assigned to: Jordan (SRE) and Liam Khan.
Emma (Customer Success): will keep customers posted. Anyone want me to run a quick list of high-usage tenants to CC?
Runtime Eng: yes please, top 10 streaming tenants for EU.
Liam Khan: Confirming last_message_ts update. Will keep thread updated until we hand back to normal ops.
Jordan (SRE): closing oncall shift in 25m, handing to Maya for follow-through and postmortem lead.
Maya Tran: acknowledged, taking over. I'll compile timeline and action items.
Oncall Network: STATUS UPDATE 00:32 after mitigation: error rate down to 1.2%, streaming drop <0.8%. Upstream provider marked BRU-2 as degraded, partial restore in progress.
Incident Bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Severity reduced to P3. Continue monitoring. Next update in 15m or on significant change.
notes: mitigation: temporary BGP prepend to alternate ASN, lowered localpref to deprioritize affected upstream, streaming reconnect/backoff patch, customer communications sent
